title: Main Hand Switcher
description: Adds a simple keybind to switch your main hand
body:
# Main Hand Switcher
Main Hand Switcher is a super simple mod that just adds a keybind that allows players to toggle their main hand between their left and right hands.

Yeah, that's it

The default key is J but you can change it to anything.
Switch it to left click to brag when playing PVP.

**DISCLAIMER: I won't take responsibility for any ban caused by this mod. It's unlikely but some server owners might be a bit too strict**
